description: Shared server authentication utilities and test helpers for the gateway component, including WebSocket connection handling, device signing, token management, and configuration functions.

methods.name: nextAuthIdentityPath
methods.description: Generates a unique file path for device identity storage based on prefix, process ID, pool ID, and an incrementing sequence.

methods.name: waitForWsClose
methods.description: Waits for a WebSocket to close within a specified timeout, resolving to true if closed.

methods.name: openWs
methods.description: Opens a WebSocket connection to a specified port with optional headers.

methods.name: readConnectChallengeNonce
methods.description: Reads the connect challenge nonce from a WebSocket message, expecting a specific message type.

methods.name: openTailscaleWs
methods.description: Opens a WebSocket connection with Tailscale-specific headers.

methods.name: restoreGatewayToken
methods.description: Restores or deletes the gateway token environment variable.

methods.name: withRuntimeVersionEnv
methods.description: Runs a function within a specified environment variable context.

methods.name: expectHelloOkServerVersion
methods.description: Connects to a server and verifies its version matches the expected version.

methods.name: createSignedDevice
methods.description: Creates a signed device payload with optional token, role, and identity path.

methods.name: resolveGatewayTokenOrEnv
methods.description: Resolves the gateway token from test state or environment variable.

methods.name: approvePendingPairingIfNeeded
methods.description: Approves any pending device pairing requests.

methods.name: configureTrustedProxyControlUiAuth
methods.description: Configures trusted proxy authentication for control UI.

methods.name: writeTrustedProxyControlUiConfig
methods.description: Writes configuration for trusted proxy control UI with optional insecure auth.

methods.name: isConnectResMessage
methods.description: Checks if an object is a connect response message with a specific ID.

methods.name: sendRawConnectReq
methods.description: Sends a raw connect request over WebSocket and waits for response.

methods.name: resolvePairedTokenForDeviceIdentityPath
methods.description: Resolves the device ID and token for a given device identity path.

methods.name: startRateLimitedTokenServerWithPairedDeviceToken
methods.description: Starts a server with rate-limited token authentication and returns device info.

methods.name: ensurePairedDeviceTokenForCurrentIdentity
methods.description: Ensures the current WebSocket has a paired device token and identity.
